blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives seized an estimated P3.37 million worth of suspected shabu and an illegal firearm in a major buy-bust operation that led to the arrest of eight individuals in Barangay Botongon, Estancia town, Iloilo on Tuesday afternoon, Sept. 29. The joint operation, conducted at around 2:10 p.m., was launched by the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) Team 3 of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Region 6, Regional Intelligence Division (RID) 6, Regional Intelligence Unit (RIU) 6, and the Estancia Municipal Police Station.
